reasons: Regime: credit-led — Credit is involved — more serious than an equity-only dip.
Hedge pricing (not in composite): Put skew / cost of tail insurance expensive, Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV) moderate

indicators.label: HY credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Level 2.68% (amber ≥4.5%), 5d change +3bp (amber ≥+30bp). A fast widening is the best short-lead credit signal.

indicators.label: CCC credit spread (OAS)
indicators.detail: Junkiest credit tier — closest public proxy for the leveraged AI periphery.

indicators.label: HYG/IEF ratio (credit vs safety)
indicators.detail: High-yield ETF vs Treasuries — a same-day credit read with no FRED lag.

indicators.label: Leveraged loans (BKLN)
indicators.detail: Floating-rate senior secured loans — isolates credit risk from rate moves. Tracking HY closely (+0.4pp 10d).

indicators.label: SOFR − IORB (funding stress)
indicators.detail: Repo rate over the interest-on-reserves floor; a persistent positive spread means funding stress.

indicators.label: Funding tail (SOFR spread + Fed repo use)
indicators.detail: SOFR 99th−1st percentile 13bp (amber ≥30bp); Fed repo ops $0.0bn (3d max) (amber ≥$5bn). Needs both legs to confirm stress over calendar effects.

indicators.label: Chicago Fed NFCI
indicators.detail: Weekly financial-conditions composite; positive = tighter than average.

indicators.label: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M)
indicators.detail: ≥1.00 = backwardation — the near-coincident confirmation signal (days of lead at most).

indicators.label: Put skew / cost of tail insurance
indicators.detail: SKEW 148 (expensive ≥145), VVIX 86 (expensive ≥110). Tail insurance is expensive — you would be paying up for the tail. Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Implied vol richness (VIX pctile, IV−RV)
indicators.detail: VIX 15.1 sits at the 10th percentile of its trailing year (expensive ≥80th); 20d realized 10.5, so implied carries +4.5 vol points of premium (expensive ≥8). Cost tier, not a risk tier — excluded from the composite.

indicators.label: Periphery canaries (CRWV, ORCL)
indicators.detail: Sharp equity drops or realized-vol spikes in the debt-financed periphery stand in for CDS.

indicators.label: Breadth (RSP/SPY, % above 50dma)
indicators.detail: Narrowing breadth = fragility backdrop; slow signal, low weight.

indicators.label: Yield curve (10y−3m)
indicators.detail: Inversion is a 6–18 month gauge, not a timing signal — capped at amber.

items.headline: SoftBank launches $11B+ junk bond sale to fund next OpenAI investment tranche
items.note: SoftBank is issuing over $11B in senior unsecured bonds (on top of an already-secured $11.87B loan) to fund the $10B follow-on OpenAI payment due Oct 1, coming right after S&P moved its outlook to negative and its CDS widened to multi-year highs — concrete evidence SoftBank is loading junk-rated debt onto what S&P calls one of its weakest-credit holdings.

items.headline: CoreWeave upsizes convertible note sale to $3.7B, prices coupon at 2.875% — up from 1.75% in April
items.note: The upsized deal priced with a coupon roughly 64% higher than CoreWeave's prior 2032 convertible from April, and the initial announcement knocked the stock down ~7%, despite the company also touting $25B of new customer commitments — a real-time read on CoreWeave's rising cost of capital.

items.headline: CleanSpark's debut junk bond for Meta-anchored data center prices at 8.25% yield despite 4x oversubscription
items.note: First-ever junk bond backed by a Meta data-center lease (Sandersville, GA; $6.6B/20-yr lease) priced to yield 8.25%, about 1.75pp over the average BB-rated yield — a data point that even Meta-anchored AI infrastructure debt is clearing at speculative-grade pricing.

disclaimer: Not financial advice. No indicator reliably times crashes; this composite raises the odds of a short heads-up, nothing more.
